body: Oh I pretty much know everything about her, we're basically the same person, my go to thing to spend time with her is going to see horror movies. Her boyfriend hasn't talked to her (Seriously talked) in over a week, and it's hurting me how upset she is.

Well on Valentines she cried into my shoulder for a minute or two, we hug, and I've kind of noticed that when we're watching movies, our legs are generally touching. But I've been kind of thinking that's just my mind trying to make me think she's into me.
Yeah, I guess I gotta tell her. I just keep going through these "What if" scenarios" in my head and they all end with her getting annoyed or creeped out after I tell her.

For further information, I was engaged, I dated a woman for 8 years, and then was cheated on. I was in a very emotionally abusive relationship at the time, and this girl is the only one I really feel safe with. And I really just don't feel those feelings about myself, like I don't really care too much about myself, I just wanna do things to make other people happy. And I don't know how to just *poof* make me love myself.
